newsitem.title: MEXICO: Sigma unit says 1996 dividend one peso.
newsitem.headline: Sigma unit says 1996 dividend one peso.

text.p: Sigma Alimentos, a subsidiary of Grupo Alfa, said Thursday it will pay a dividend of one peso per share in circulation through March 5.
The dividend was approved by a shareholders assembly on Thursday, and expected to total 42 million pesos for the company.
"One peso per share was the 1996 dividend," company director Armando Garza Sada said at a press conference.
Garza added that the company will invest $32 million this year and expects volume to increase at least double the expected 4.5 to five percent gross domestic product rise.

"The more important investment is in a cheese plant, of close to $11 million, after $6 million dollars in distribution and point of sale, $5 (million) in investments related to the Yugurth business and the rest in different operating investments," Garza said.
The cheese plant will be constructed in Lagos de Moreno, in western Jalisco state, he added.
Garza said the company will be aided in financing the investment by banks.
Sigma's investment reached 3.34 billion pesos in 1996, an increase of 11 percent from the year before.
In 1997 the company plans to increase its production capacity 10 percent, Garza said.
He said the company sees up to 60 percent of its exports going to Hong Kong, a new market for the company where shipments of more than 1,000 tonnes monthly will begin in April.
